searchText: Does geth still support comms without auth? I'm getting `the method engine_newPayloadV1 does not exist/is not available` on the non-auth API even with `--http.api eth,engine`. yes we still support the engine without auth (at least we should) https://github.com/MariusVanDerWijden/go-ethereum/commit/df4d869cfb3400be862ffb03bb47291e3baa478a Hey. I am not 100% sure. What is the current consensus about ports? 8550 -> no-auth -> websockets;http 8551 -> auth -> webscoktes;http Is that correct? cc: <@!491624610215886849> <@!360491619402776577> <@!792822129019584562> <@!425572898787426305> Yes, we have decided on the call that software will follow the spec, and the spec defines non-auth/auth ports in the way you have mentioned Been trying to use lodestar x geth with JWT and stumbled upon some issues: - If I don't explicitly provide ` --eth1.providerUrls http://127.0.0.1:8545`, I'll get a bunch of `FetchError: request to http://localhost:8545/ failed, reason: connect ECONNREFUSED ::1:8545` errors - If I specify `--eth1.providerUrls http://127.0.0.1:8551` and `--jwt-secret="../datadir-lh/geth/jwtsecret"` I get `Error: Forbidden: missing token` (it seems to correctly read the file, if I specify a non-existing file it errors during read) umm, my interop with geth works fine (we have auth interop with geth in CI as well) could you use space instead of = (we haven't yet updated the defaults so you might need to specify them explicitly the way you have done as of now) dm-ing you to help figure this out just thinking aloud: we don't use the jwt token on the eth_ requests that lodestar's deposit/terminal pow tracker sends out even if one provides secret as its only applied to engine requests, so if that end point is protected it will error

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content: Does geth still support comms without auth? I'm getting `the method engine_newPayloadV1 does not exist/is not available` on the non-auth API even with `--http.api eth,engine`.

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: yes we still support the engine without auth

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
Hey. I am not 100% sure. What is the current consensus about ports?

8550 -> no-auth -> websockets;http
8551 -> auth -> webscoktes;http

Is that correct?

cc: <@!491624610215886849> <@!360491619402776577> <@!792822129019584562> <@!425572898787426305>

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: Yes, we have decided on the call that software will follow the spec, and the spec defines non-auth/auth ports in the way you have mentioned

Been trying to use lodestar x geth with JWT and stumbled upon some issues:
- If I don't explicitly provide ` --eth1.providerUrls http://127.0.0.1:8545`, I'll get a bunch of `FetchError: request to http://localhost:8545/ failed, reason: connect ECONNREFUSED ::1:8545` errors
- If I specify `--eth1.providerUrls http://127.0.0.1:8551` and `--jwt-secret="../datadir-lh/geth/jwtsecret"` I get `Error: Forbidden: missing token` (it seems to correctly read the file, if I specify a non-existing file it errors during read)
